audience: General curious adult. No science background assumed.
core_message: Algae are microscopic, easy to overlook, and responsible for about half the oxygen you breathe.
tone: Wonder, grounded in fact. Calm authority, not hype.

route.visuals: Remotion Explainer composition, component-driven scenes — no AI image generation
route.music: none — narration-led at 30s; music would crowd a dense VO
route.theme: custom themeConfig override (deep-ocean teal / bioluminescent green)

theme_rationale: The four built-in themes are all wrong for this subject: flat-motion-graphics is purple fintech, clean-professional is corporate blue, minimalist-diagram is red/white editorial, anime-ghibli is warm amber. resolveTheme() accepts a full themeConfig object override, so the video gets an ocean palette that matches the content instead of borrowing an unrelated brand identity.

verified_contract.props_interface: ExplainerProps { cuts: Cut[], overlays?, captions?, audio? }
verified_contract.note: All scene type strings and component props verified by reading Explainer.tsx and components/ directly, not assumed.
